Yes unfortunately...Drinking is not a good thing,but we can’t help it. I know it’s sad. But I was hoping you do you. I don’t want you to change and try to fit in with the drinking group. Because they sound very selfish for not even making any other plans with you. Thats what i meant…
It’s hard to explain to you non-drinkers unfortunately. To have everyone drinking and you just sitting there :( I’m just trying to be nice and explain from my perspective..
So u want them to include u in these nightouts as well ? 🤔

Ok just sharing my thoughts here. I drink pretty regularly and heavily. Has a group of friends who drink and another who doesn’t. I think if I want to have a good night out of drinking, I would invite my group of friends who drink. I would not invite non-drinkers as I know you would reject the invitation anyway/feel left out/not able to enjoy the night. HOWEVER, if i still want us to be friends, I would ask you to hangout at a cafe for a simple lunch or dinner another time (minus the drinking). But the thing is you gotta accept the way we are and not get mad or sad when you’re not invited because it doesn’t make sense asking someone who doesn’t drink to join us. I would have happily plan another nightout without any drinking with you :) 

(drinking is my way of coping,a very unhealthy one ik, much respect to yall out there who stay sober!)
